Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the run chase as the umpires make their way out to the middle. The New Zealand players are taking their positions on the field as Kusal Mendis and Pathum Nissanka stride out toward the pitch. They will open the innings for Sri Lanka and will be looking to negotiate the new ball thereby getting their team off to a good start. Tim Southee has been handed the ball and will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, this game could go either way as the Sri Lankan batters have shown that they have ample ability to complete this run chase but they also have the tendency to collapse under pressure. They will be up against one of the most dangerous fast-bowling attacks and will be hoping to play out the new ball and build their inning. The momentum is with New Zealand though and they will come out with fire looking to take early wickets and defend the target comfortably. Do join us shortly for an exciting run chase.

Daryl Mitchell is up for a chat and he says that he is happy with the total and applauds the efforts of Glenn Phillips. Adds that it was a challenging start for them and the key was to build a partnership and overall the surface is a bit difficult. Mentions that there is some variable bounce on offer and will now look to defend this total.

New Zealand found themselves in an uncommon situation where both their openers failed with the bat as they found their stumps shattered by the Sri Lankan spinners. Kane Williamson could not steady the ship as he fell soon after and New Zealand put up their second-worst performance in a Powerplay in a T20 World Cup. Glenn Phillips got a life as he was dropped in the deep early in his innings and along with Daryl Mitchell began rebuilding the inning. They put on a partnership of 84 runs in just 64 deliveries with Glenn Phillips being the major contributor as he notched up his century and played an outstanding inning. New Zealand will be silently confident of defending this total with the bowling attack they have.

Sri Lanka got off to a dream start with Dasun Shanaka shuffling his bowlers well at the start of the inning. Maheesh Theekshana struck in the first over of the game and Dhananjaya de Silva followed suit with a dismissal in his first over as well. Kasun Rajitha had an extended spell and dismissed the New Zealand skipper to restrict the opponents to 25 runs in the Powerplay having claimed three wickets. Pathum Nissanka spilled an easy chance to dismiss Glen Phillips which proved to be the turning point as he went on to be the difference for New Zealand. Wanindu Hasaranga broke the fourth wicket partnership but by then the platform had been set and their death bowlers faced the brunt of the onslaught towards the end. Kasun Rajitha was the pick of the bowlers taking 2 wickets for 23 runs in his four overs with the three spinners taking one wicket each.

What an outstanding effort this has been from Glenn Phillips as he has scored 104 out of the total of 167 runs that are on the board! The Kiwis have managed to put up a decent score and Sri Lanka will be absolutely disappointed with their effort after the start they had. The momentum is definitely with New Zealand and they have a wonderful opportunity to notch up their second win of the tournament. Sri Lanka have their work cut out and will have to pick themselves up if they are to put up a fight and try and reach the target.

FOUR! Tim Southee walks in and applies the finishing touch to end the innings on a high. This is a low full toss outside off, Southee reaches out and clubs it towards the vacant wide long on fence for a boundary. 13 runs come off the final over and New Zealand finish with 167/7 on the board.
Tim Southee will face the last ball of the inning.

OUT! RUN OUT! Comfortably short in the end. Lahiru Kumara gets bowling the off-paced deliveries, this time it is on a length and around off. Ish Sodhi drags the shot towards deep mid-wicket and there's a slight fumble in the deep as well. The batters try to come back for the second but the substitute fielder over there Ashen Bandara fires in a good throw towards the keeper. Kusal Mendis whips off the bails and the replays show that Ish Sodhi is short of his ground.
Commentary.Howout: run out (sub Ashen Bandara / Kusal Mendis)

Commentary.Commentary: Ish Sodhi is out in the middle for the last two balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Glenn Phillips finally mistimes one and departs after a fine, fine knock. Another slower one from Lahiru Kumara, bowled into the pitch and outside off. Phillips just loses his shape a bit as he looks to go over the long off fence. The ball goes off the top edge and just over mid off. Dasun Shanaka runs backward and takes a good catch. Kumara gets the wicket but Phillips has done the damage.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one, on a good length and over the stumps. Mitchell Santner gets an inside edge towards the off side as he looks to pull and the batters scamper through for a run.
SIX! Up and over! A short ball over the off stump, Mitchell Santner gives himself a bit of room and just lifts it all the way over the point fence for a maximum.

Another attempted wide yorker, slower this time and ends up being a low full toss. Glenn Phillips looks to swing across the line but gets an inside edge back onto the pads. The ball rolls on the off side and they get a single.
WIDE! Attempted wide yorker, this is pushed beyond the tramline outside off and a wide is called.
Maheesh Theekshana drops it short again and Glenn Phillips pulls it on the bounce to the deep mid-wicket fielder for only a single.

FOUR! A huge roar from Glenn Phillips as he finds the fence and brings up a sensational ton. This is dragged down on the pads, Phillips rocks back and pulls it hard into the mid-wicket fence. Phillips gets a standing ovation from the crowd and rightly so, this has been a knock of high calliber.
A full toss on the pads, Mitchell Santner sweeps it towards deep square leg for just a single.
Excellent running! Tossed up outside off, Mitchell Santner drives it firmly in front of covers and the batters race back for the second.
Quicker and shorter over the stumps, Glenn Phillips backs away and lofts it towards wide long off for a single.

FOUR! Raw power! Shorter and on leg stump, Glenn Phillips pulls this one off the back foot and straight down the ground splitting the long off and long on fielders. Another boundary for Phillips and he is just one hit away from a century.
Pitched up, around off, this is driven through mid off for a single.
And again! Slower delivery, fuller and outside off, Glenn Phillips throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to make a connection.
Well bowled and thankfully for Kasun Rajitha, the no balls don't cost much. Slower one, on a length and outside off, Glenn Phillips looks to cut but is undone by the lack of pace.

NO BALL! This is poor from Kasun Rajitha as he bowls another no ball. Full and outside off, Glenn Phillips opens the face of the bat and guides it to the left of the man at third man for a couple of runs. Free Git to continue...

NO BALL AND FOUR! Glenn Phillips almost falls over and yet manages to get it where he wants. This is a low full toss on middle, Phillips shuffles across but then is able to broom it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Free Hit to follow...
Nicely bowled! This is full and wide but also slower. Glenn Phillips shuffles in his crease and looks for the big shot but misses.
Good length, around off, this is eased away towards cover-point for one.
WIDE! Shorter and down the leg side, left alone for a wide.
Mitchell Santner makes his way out to middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kasun Rajitha comes back for his final over and strikes immediately. Rajitha bowls this one slower at just 109 KPH and on a hard length, well outside off. James Neesham has to wait for it and in the end, also has to reach out for it. Neesham tries to loft it over covers but can't get much timing on it. The ball comes flat and to the left of the man at cover. Dasun Shanaka over there is quick to react and moves to that side to take the catch. Neesham departs early and Sri Lanka now have a chance of tightening the screws.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! This is sliding down leg, James Neesham misses the flick and gets it off the pads towards fine leg. They get a single. 16 off the over, another big one for New Zealand.
This is speared into off stump, Glenn Phillips stays deep and pushes it out on the off side for a single.

SIX! Back-to-back maximums! This is dragged down over middle and leg, Glenn Phillips backs away and swats it flat back over the bowler's head and clears the ropes with ease. Phillips is eyeing a century here.

SIX! Glenn Phillips is seeing the ball big out there. Phillips shows all three of his stumps as he stands past the leg stump and Maheesh Theekshana bowls it outside off. Phillips reaches out and powers it all the way over the wide long off fence for a biggie.
This is darted in from around off, James Neesham steps out and hits it on the full towards wide long off for a single.
This is pushed through fuller and well outside off, James Neesham looks for the reverse sweep but misses.
WIDE! Maheesh Theekshana starts off the new spell with a full and wide one, a bit too wide though for the umpire's liking.
A good short ball, at 141 clicks and over middle and leg. James Neesham climbs on top of it and pulls it through square leg for one.
Length ball, around off, this is eased away onto the off side for a single.
SIX! BANG! Slower one, right in the slot and Glenn Phillips has picked it up. Phillips opens up the front leg and then straightens it up before muscling it back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Banged in short and around off, James Neesham clubs it off the toe end of the bat towards his batting partner. Phillips gets out of the way and they get across for a single.
Nicely timed but straight to the man. This is bowled slower and fuller, outside off, Glenn Phillips drives it towards cover for another quick run.
Good length, angling across the left-hander. James Neesham stays back and dabs it down towards the vacant slip cordon for a quick single.
Lahiru Kumara (1-0-12-0) is back on.
Bowls this into the pads on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips clips this towards deep mid-wicket with soft hands and they run well once again to collect two runs.
Flights this one full and outside off, Glenn Phillips defends the ball towards the cover fielder.
Bowls this full and straight as well, James Neesham sweeps this to deep square leg and takes a run to get off the mark.
James Neesham is in at number 6.

OUT! TIMBER! The partnership has been broken and Wanindu Hasaranga gets the wicket he has been craving for! Bowls a googly full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell looks to heave this straight back over the bowler but the ball beats the inside edge and rattles the stumps. Sri Lanka really needed this wicket as it brings an end to Daryl Mitchell's labored inning.
Bowls this straight and on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips works this to long on and takes a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Wanindu Hasaranga as he serves this short and wide outside off. Glenn Phillips uses the depth of the crease and thumps the ball wide of long off for four runs.
Wanindu Hasaranga to finish off his spell here.
Slower delivery bowled full and outside off, Glenn Phillips strokes this to deep cover and takes a single to keep strike.

FOUR! This has been crunched away! Glenn Phillips and New Zealand getting a move on now. This is bowled full and wide outside the off pole, Glenn Phillips times this beautifully as the ball races to the deep point boundary for four more runs.
WIDE! This is bowled on a good length but way outside off and the umpire indicates that it is wide.
This is bowled full and outside off, Glenn Phillips strokes this to deep cover and more poor fielding allows the batters to complete two runs.

FOUR! That is fifty for Glenn Phillips and gets there in fine fashion! Chamika Karunaratne bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips gets down on one knee and sweeps the fast bowler towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.

Another chance goes begging! Chamika Karunaratne bowls this wide outside off on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips stretches and reaches for the ball. He is unable to connect well and the ball lobs up towards long off. Dasun Shanaka comes running in from the deep and dives forward but is unable to take a difficult chance They take two runs in the process.

FOUR! The dropped catch is proving to be expensive for Sri Lanka! Glenn Phillips is now one hit away from a half-century as he dispatches this length ball outside off to the deep cover boundary for four runs!
Bowls this one short and outside off, Daryl Mitchell rocks back and cuts this late and another misfield from the point fielder allows them to take two runs to end the over.
Flighted delivery bowled full and straight, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep but finds the short third man fielder.
This is on a fuller length and just outside off, Daryl Mitchell thumps this to straight long off and they are able to take a couple of runs.
A loose delivery bowled full and really wide outside off, Glenn Phillips reaches for it and lifts it over the infield but finds the deep cover fielder and takes one.
Bowls this one short and outside off, Glenn Phillips mistimes his shot straight to cover.
Wanindu Hasaranga flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell charges down the wicket and blocks the ball to the leg side for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga (2-0-8-0) is back on.
Six slower balls in the over as this one is served wide outside off on a good length. Glenn Phillips swings but gets beaten and moans loudly as he knows he missed out here.
This is bowled on a shorter length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell hits the slower delivery to deep cover and rotates the strike with a single.

Bowls this one really wide outside off and bowls the leg cutter again on a fuller length. Glenn Phillips waits on the ball and cuts it to the left of the point fielder who gets a hand on it but the batters take three runs.
Continues to take pace off the ball and serves this outside off on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips swings his bat but is beaten by the pace.
Bowls a leg cutter this time on a good length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell miscues this to deep cover for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne bowls a slower delivery full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell mistimes his shot towards long off and they take two courtesy of a misfield.
A loopy delivery served on a shorter length and outside off, Glenn Phillips punches this to wide long off and they run well once again to take another couple of runs.
Bowls this one short and angling down leg, Daryl Mitchell misses out as he finds the deep backward square leg fielder and they take another run.
Floats this one outside off on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips gets on one knee and sweeps this hard to deep backward square leg and takes one.
Continues bowling full and on the pads, Glenn Phillips taps this towards deep mid-wicket with soft hands and they run well to take two runs.
Flights this full and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips sweeps the ball to deep backward square leg and completes a brace.
Dhananjaya de Silva starts from 'round the wicket and attacks the pads on a fuller length, Daryl Mitchell clips this ball towards mid-wicket and takes one.

DRINKS! This has been a wonderful start for Sri Lanka and they have been controlling proceedings in this game after a wonderful Powerplay. The drop catch of Glenn Phillips could prove to be expensive for them as there is a steady partnership building for New Zealand and they will be looking to accelerate after the break. The Islanders will be hoping for a few quick wickets and keep the pressure on as we expect much more excitement to come our way.
This is full and straight, right in the blockhole yet again. Glenn Phillips defends it back to the bowler and at the halfway stage, New Zealand are 54/3.

Nicely bowled! back of the hand slower delivery right in the blockhole and at the toes. Glenn Phillips looks to squeeze it out on the leg side but misses. There is an appeal for lbw but it is sliding down leg it seems.

SIX! A brilliant pickup shot from Glenn Phillips and he is looking solid at the moment. Just a fraction shorter and on leg stump, Phillips gets under it and lifts it over the final leg fence for a maximum. The 50 is also up for New Zealand.
Fast hands from Glenn Phillips this time. Fullish length, outside off and this is thrashed away behind point for a couple of runs.
Pace on this time, a touch fuller and angling into the pads. Glenn Phillips looks to flick it off the back foot but gets hurried on and hit high on the pads.
Chamika Karunaratne comes into the attack now and starts off with a leg cutter around the pads. Daryl Mitchell waits for it and whips it away towards deep square leg for a single.
This one is pushed through quicker and on off stump, Glenn Phillips solidly keeps it out off the front foot.
Shorter and around off, turning away, Daryl Mitchell rocks back and pulls it down to wide long on for one more.
Around off, Phillips pushes it down the ground towards long off and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air and around leg stump, Glenn Phillips tucks it away towards short fine leg.
On the shorter and on off stump, turning away. Daryl Mitchell plays it off the back foot and down to long on for a run.
Around middle and leg, Daryl Mitchell tickles it down to short fine leg.
Slower one, pitched up and outside off. Daryl Mitchell knocks it down to long on for one. A fruitful over for New Zealand as 12 runs come off it.
Full and straight at 141 clicks, Glenn Phillips flicks it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! An attempted slower delivery, full and well down the leg side. This is left alone for a wide.

Banged in short and over the stumps, Glenn Phillips looks to force the big shot over wide long on but gets it off the higher part of the bat. The catch is dropped in the deep and the batters race back for two as well.

This is served on a hard length and over off stump, Daryl Mitchell stays deep in his crease as he looks to swing across the line. The ball goes off the inside edge and towards fine leg for a single. Kumara has overstepped and a no ball is called. Free Hit to follow...
A tad fuller now and angling it in from outside off, Daryl Mitchell mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around off, this is dabbed away towards cover-point for a quick single.

FOUR! Lahiru Kumara begins his spell with a wayward delivery. This is short and down the leg side, Glenn Phillips looks to pull but gets a glove on it and the ball runs fine. The fielder at fine leg sprints to his right but the ball beats him into the fence.
Flatter delivery, around off, Daryl Mitchell nudges it out on the off side.

DROPPED! Pathum Nissanka lets go of a straightforward chance and Wanindu Hasaranga cannot believe it. This is nicely tossed up around off stump, Glenn Phillips looks to go inside-out over extra cover but ends up hitting it flat and down the throat of the man at long off. Nissanka just cannot quite settle himself and the ball pops in and out of his hands. A single is taken.
Around middle, Daryl Mitchell uses his wrists to work it in front of mid-wicket for a run.
Floated up, around the off stump, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep and gets it fine. The fielder from short third man chases it down and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Tosses it up now, full and on off stump, Glenn Phillips drives it down to long off for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes into the attack now and starts off with a wrong 'un. This one skids on from around the off pole and Phillips watchfully keeps it out.

Full and on off stump, Glenn Phillips drives it firmly to the left of the fielder at mid off who fumbles a bit. The batters scamper through for one and at the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand are 25/3.

Slightly pitched up on off stump and this one just nips back in off the deck. Glenn Phillips waits for it and pushes it out towards mid off. Good comeback by Kasun Rajitha after being hit for a boundary early in the over.
A slower one now, full and angling onto the pads. Glenn Phillips flicks it away towards mid-wicket.
On a hard length and around off, Glenn Phillips punches it off the back foot and finds the man at extra cover.
FOUR! A real loosener from Kasun Rajitha and that will ease the Kiwi nerves a bit. Short and wide, Glenn Phillips stays put and slaps it into the cover-point fence.
Good length, slanting onto the pads, Daryl Mitchell shuffles across and whips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Continues bowling full and straight, Daryl Mitchell shimmies down the wicket and looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards square leg and they take a run.
This is full as well and angled into the stumps, Daryl Mitchell clips the ball towards mid-wicket.
This comes in sharpy from outside off on a fuller length, Glenn Phillips taps this towards mid on and takes a quick single.
Fires this into the pads on a fuller length, Daryl Mitchell flicks this past short third man and takes an easy run.
Bowled at the stumps on a full length, Glenn Phillips works this to mid on and takes one.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips goes back in the crease and just about manages to get his bat down in time to keep the ball out.
Daryl Mitchell walks out to bat with New Zealand in a spot of bother. Also, Maheesh Theekshana comes back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sri Lanka have found their thrid wicket and they are right on top of the New Zealand batters at the moment! The captain of New Zealand, Kane Williamson has to depart and leaves his team in all sorts of trouble. Kasun Rajitha goes short this time and outside off, Kane Williamson gets on his toes and looks to work this towards the off side but only manages a faint nick to Kusal Mendis behind the wicket. The umpire raises his finger and Kane Williamson walks.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Slower delivery bowled full and in lien with the stumps, Kane Williamson taps this towards mid on.
Bowls full this time and outside the off stump, Kane Williamson defends this towards cover.
FOUR! This has been swatted away! Kasun Rajitha bowls short once again but this one sits up nicely outside off for Kane Williamson to rock back and pull this towards deep square leg for four runs.
What a jaffa! Kasun Rajitha continues bowling back of a length and gets the ball to move away from outside off, Kane Williamson hangs his bat out to dry and is beaten by the extra bounce.
Kasun Rajitha bowls this back of a length and just outside off, Kane Williamson blocks this awkwardly back down the pitch.
This is slightly short and angling down leg, Glenn Phillips flicks this towards backward square leg. End of another successful over for Sri Lanka.
Flighted full and outside off, Glenn Phillips gets a stride forward and defends the ball to the left of the bowler.

FOUR! Glenn Phillips is off the mark in style! Dhananjaya de Silva bowls this slightly short and outside the off pole, Glenn Phillips rocks back in the crease and thumps the ball through the gap in the off side and finds the deep cover boundary for four runs.
Bowls this one full and outside off, Glenn Phillips blocks this towards cover-point and looks for a single that is not there.
Glenn Phillips is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! New Zealand have lost two in a hurry and Sri Lanka are right on top! The bowling changes seem to be working here as Dhananjaya de Silva strikes in his first over. He serves a full delivery from 'round the wicket to the left-hander and angles it into the stumps, Devon Conway looks to make room and shuffles forward to lift the ball over the off side but misses and watched his stumps get shattered. This had been a dream start for Sri Lanka and they will be looking to apply the pressure now.
Dhananjaya de Silva fires one full and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson works this down to long on and takes a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva to roll his arm now.
Kasun Rajitha serves this outside off and pulls his length back a fraction. Kane Williamson shimmies down the wicket and works this ball to deep backward point and takes a run to keep strike.
Delivers this on the outside off stump line on a good length, Kane Williamson defends this towards point.
Strays onto the pads on a good length, Devon Conway clips this to short third man who spills the ball and they collect a leg bye.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off stump, Kane Williamson guides this to wide third man and takes a single.
Lovely delivery! Bowls this on a good length and just outside the off pole, Kane Williamson looks to play but decides to leave it at the last moment as the ball moves away.
Kasun Rajitha starts with a back-of-a-length delivery served outside off, Kane Williamson slashes at this but finds the cover-point fielder.
Kasun Rajitha to operate from the other end.
Floats this one full and just outside the off stump, Devon Conway gets his front foot forward and taps the ball towards short mid off. One wicket and 3 runs from the first over.
Goes slightly fuller this time but continues to attack the stumps, Kane Williamson punches this down to long on and takes a run to get off the mark.
Kane Williamson, the Kiwi skipper walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Maheesh Theekshana strikes straight away and Sri Lanka have drawn first blood! He serves a slightly short delivery and moves back into the stumps from outside off, Finn Allen looks to make room and cut it square. He is unable to connect and the ball pegs the off pole back sending the opening batter back to the shed. Just the start Sri Lanka needed and this game has opened up now.
Devon Conway is off the mark now. Maheesh Theekshana goes 'round the wicket and fires this full and on the pads, Devon Conway clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes one.
Bowls this on a fraction short and outside off, Finn Allen rocks back and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
Maheesh Theekshana begins with a full delivery angled into the pads, Finn Allen blocks this back towards the bowler.

All in readiness for the start of play now as the umpires take their place out in the middle. The players of Sri Lanka also spread out on the field. Devon Conway and Finn Allen are all-set to open the innings for New Zealand. It will be spin to get the game underway as Maheesh Theekshana has been tossed the new ball. Let's play...

We are just a few minutes away from the start now. But first, the players from both sides will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be the national anthem of Sri Lanka first followed by New Zealand's national anthem.

Finn Allen is down for a quick chat. He says it feels pretty good to bat well against a quality pace attack like Australia. Mentions that they are fortunate to have a couple of quality spinners on their side and the key is to look to play straight down the ground. Adds that he and Devon Conway have been batting together for a couple of years now and it feels good to bat alongside him.

PITCH REPORT - Mel Jones was pitchside earlier and she says it's 84m dead straight. Adds that the pitch looks like a belter. Dale Steyn joins her and says that it is similar to the previous two wickets on this ground.

Dasun Shanaka the captain of Sri Lanka says they would have batted first too but they are comfortable while chasing and they have no problem doing so. When asked about the loss against Australia he explains that it is just one game as spinners hold the key for them but they had a bad game. Claims that the hope to regroup and do well in this game. Informs there is just one change for them.

Kane Williamson the skipper of New Zealand says that they will have a bat first and says that the surface looks good. Adds that they have traveled quite a fair bit and it is good to be back out in the middle. Mentions that the conditions are different at different grounds and they look to make the adjustments. Informs that they have one change in the side as Daryl Mitchell comes back in for Mark Chapman.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Lahiru Kumara, Kasun Rajitha (In place of Binura Fernando).

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Devon Conway (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell (In place of Mark Chapman), James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee, Lockie Ferguson, Trent Boult.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of New Zealand. They have elected to BAT first.

Sri Lanka saw their three-game winning streak broken by Australia and will be eager to get back to winnings ways as a victory would take them to the top of the table. They looked tired in their last game and the tournament has been considerably longer for them having played three extra games in the Group Stage. They possess the ability to beat any team in the world if it is their day but they will have to look for consistency if they are to make a title run. They have a strong batting order and though the top order has been scoring runs heavily, they need their power hitters to join the party and provide them with the impetus at the backend of an inning. They missed the contributions of their spinners in the previous match and will be hoping they get their mojo back in this game. Will they be able to overcome their loss? Or will New Zealand prove to be too strong for them? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.
